system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate an Ansible playbook that configures a static network interface on a Debian 12 host using the netplan module, with a specified IP, gateway, and DNS servers.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Generate an Ansible playbook that configures a static network interface on a Debian 12 host using the netplan module, with a specified IP, gateway, and DNS servers.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Configure static network interface via Netplan on Debian 12
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    netplan_interface: "eth0"
    netplan_ip_cidr: "192.168.1.50/24"
    netplan_gateway: "192.168.1.1"
    netplan_dns_servers:
      - "1.1.1.1"
      - "9.9.9.9"
    netplan_dns_search:
      - "example.local"
    netplan_config_path: "/etc/netplan/01-static-{{ netplan_interface }}.yaml"
    netplan_renderer: "networkd"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure host is Debian 12 (bookworm)
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
          - ansible_facts['distribution_major_version'] == '12'
        fail_msg: "This playbook targets Debian 12 only."

    - name: Ensure netplan.io is installed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: netplan.io
        state: present
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure /etc/netplan exists with secure permissions
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/netplan
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Find existing netplan configuration files
      ansible.builtin.find:
        paths: /etc/netplan
        patterns: "*.yaml"
        excludes: "{{ netplan_config_path | basename }}"
      register: existing_netplan_files

    - name: Back up pre-existing netplan configuration files
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "{{ item.path }}"
        dest: "{{ item.path }}.bak"
        remote_src: true
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0600"
        force: false
      loop: "{{ existing_netplan_files.files }}"
      when: existing_netplan_files.matched | int > 0

    - name: Remove other netplan YAML files to avoid conflicts
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: absent
      loop: "{{ existing_netplan_files.files }}"
      when: existing_netplan_files.matched | int > 0

    - name: Render netplan static configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ netplan_config_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0600"
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - do not edit manually
          network:
            version: 2
            renderer: {{ netplan_renderer }}
            ethernets:
              {{ netplan_interface }}:
                dhcp4: false
                dhcp6: false
                accept-ra: false
                addresses:
                  - {{ netplan_ip_cidr }}
                routes:
                  - to: default
                    via: {{ netplan_gateway }}
                nameservers:
                  search: {{ netplan_dns_search | to_json }}
                  addresses: {{ netplan_dns_servers | to_json }}
      register: netplan_config

    - name: Validate netplan configuration (generate)
      ansible.builtin.command: netplan generate
      changed_when: false

    - name: Apply netplan configuration
      ansible.builtin.command: netplan apply
      when: netplan_config.changed
      async: 30
      poll: 0

    - name: Wait for host to become reachable on new address
      ansible.builtin.wait_for_connection:
        delay: 5
        timeout: 60

    - name: Gather updated network facts
      ansible.builtin.setup:
        gather_subset:
          - network

    - name: Verify configured IP address is present on interface
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - (netplan_ip_cidr | ansible.utils.ipaddr('address')) in (ansible_facts['all_ipv4_addresses'] | default([]))
        fail_msg: "Configured IP {{ netplan_ip_cidr }} not present on host after netplan apply."
